name: Bridget Brooks

positions.statement: In an October 2026 Tualatin Life column, Brooks says she promised to listen and protect the community's health and financial strength.
positions.excerpt: I promised to listen, protect our community’s health & financial strength, and move forward without leaving people behind.

positions.statement: In an October 2026 Tualatin Life column, Brooks names traffic, rising costs and aging infrastructure as continuing challenges.
positions.excerpt: We still face traffic, rising costs, & aging infrastructure.

positions.statement: In an October 2026 Tualatin Life column, Brooks says she urged the city to become a trauma-informed organization.
positions.excerpt: I also urged the city to become a trauma-informed organization.
